scope: 152 reviewed candidates; installed dove and bakussa derivatives are separate

method.contrast: Median across frames of p90 linear-sRGB luminance contrast over alpha >=32 pixels; low <2.0. Heuristic, not accessibility certification. Intentional fades require visual interpretation.
method.drawing_bbox: Union of pixels with alpha >=32 across every frame; size includes movement.
method.small_source: Raster source longest side <64px. CSS vectors excluded.
method.thin_drawing: Visible union shortest side <24px; deliberate bars can legitimately match.
method.memory: Decoded RGBA frame buffers only; excludes loader, graphics work buffers, compression, allocator overhead. Not a receiver CPU measurement.
method.modifications: None: all original artwork, archives, installed package, updater and Trezor unchanged.
